title: Measured edit risk before a change
why: An agent can ask how risky an edit is before making it: a deterministic score with its factors and the exact checks that prove the edit safe.
changelog: `brain risk <target> [--measure] --json` and MCP `brain_risk` measure the risk of an edit

adopt.snippet:
## Edit risk (locate → risk → change → verify)
Before editing a shared component, route, resource or `tokens.cssbrain`, run `brain risk <target> --json`.
